title: 1Password vs LastPass
description: 1Password vs LastPass: 1Password is our overall pick for Security & Compliance teams — 1Password 4.6/5, LastPass 4.1/5; 1Password from $7.99/mo.

features.name: Free tier availability
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers a free trial period to evaluate the platform. Free tiers include core functionality with usage limits.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides a free tier for small teams. Freemium models reduce initial investment risk.

features.name: Entry-level pricing
features.tool1Detail: 1Password starts at Paid ($7.99/mo per user). This tier supports small teams with core features. See Security & Compliance pricing guide.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass begins at Freemium (Free – $6/user/mo). TCO should include per-user fees, storage overages, and premium add-ons.

features.name: Enterprise pricing
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers custom enterprise pricing with SLA-backed support and advanced security. Includes audit logging and data residency.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides enterprise tiers with volume discounts. SSO, compliance certs, and custom SLAs included.

features.name: Annual discount
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers 15-20% savings with annual billing. TCO cost reduction for committed teams with multi-year contract options.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides annual billing with 15-25% savings. SaaS pricing analysis confirms typical annual commitment benefits.

features.name: Free trial duration
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides a 14-30 day free trial with access to all core features. This trial period allows teams to thoroughly evaluate the platform against their specific workflows, test integrations with existing tools, and assess overall performance before making a financial commitment. Many teams use this period to run parallel operations and validate migration paths.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers a similar trial duration with full feature access. We strongly recommend our structured evaluation checklist to maximize trial effectiveness, including checking integration compatibility, testing API endpoints, and evaluating performance under your typical workload conditions.

features.name: Contract flexibility
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers month-to-month, annual, and multi-year contract options. Monthly billing provides flexibility for teams still evaluating fit, while annual contracts reduce per-unit costs. SaaS contract terms typically include usage-based scaling and add-on modules.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides flexible contract terms with monthly and annual options. Multi-year commitments often include additional discounts and waived implementation fees for enterprise customers.

features.name: Usage-based scaling
features.tool1Detail: 1Password scales pricing based on team size, storage, and feature tier. Usage-based pricing ensures you only pay for what you need, with automatic upgrades as your team grows. Industry benchmarks help forecast costs at scale.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers similar usage-based scaling with clear upgrade paths. TCO modeling should include expected growth over 12-24 months when comparing platforms.

features.name: User role management
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides RBAC with customizable permission levels supporting complex hierarchies and compliance.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers role management with SCIM provisioning for SSO-based user lifecycle management.

features.name: Two-factor authentication
features.tool1Detail: 1Password supports 2FA via TOTP, SMS, and FIDO2 hardware keys. Zero-trust benefits from MFA enforcement.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides 2FA with authenticator apps and biometrics on mobile. Encryption combined with 2FA provides defense-in-depth.

features.name: Audit logging
features.tool1Detail: 1Password maintains audit trails for actions and changes. Compliance-ready exports support SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides activity logging with searchable history. SIEM integration enables centralized monitoring.

features.name: Mobile app
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers native iOS and Android apps with push notifications and offline access for mobile workforce productivity.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides mobile apps. Remote team collaboration supported via mobile-optimized interfaces.

features.name: Search functionality
features.tool1Detail: 1Password features full-text search with filters. AI-powered search suggests relevant results based on usage patterns.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides search with filtering. Global search helps teams find information across workspaces.

features.name: Template library
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides pre-built templates for common workflows. Custom templates support branding and standardization.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers template collections for industries. Workflow templates speed implementation.

features.name: Community ecosystem
features.tool1Detail: 1Password has a large community. Community contributions extend functionality via plugins and shared resources.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass maintains growing community with user groups and forums.

features.name: Onboarding experience
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers guided onboarding with tutorials and setup wizards. Self-paced learning accelerates proficiency.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides documentation, video tutorials, and live training. Knowledge base covers setup scenarios.

features.name: Multi-language support
features.tool1Detail: 1Password supports multiple languages with localized interfaces. International teams benefit from regional format support.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides multi-language with interface translations. i18n supports global collaboration.

features.name: Custom branding
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides white-label options with custom domain and branding for client portals.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers branding customization with custom themes and domain config on business plans.

features.name: Bulk operations
features.tool1Detail: 1Password supports batch processing for data management. API-based bulk operations handle large datasets efficiently, with progress tracking and error reporting built into the workflow.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers bulk import/export in CSV and JSON formats. Scheduled bulk operations support automated data synchronization between systems.

features.name: Data portability
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides full data export capabilities in multiple formats including JSON, CSV, and PDF. API-based data access ensures you maintain control of your information at all times. GDPR data portability requirements are fully supported.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass supports data portability through export tools and API access. Migration in or out of the platform is designed to minimize friction for growing teams.

features.name: Offline mode
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides offline functionality with automatic sync when connectivity is restored. This is critical for field teams, traveling professionals, and environments with unreliable internet access.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers limited offline capabilities with local caching of recent data. Mobile apps provide the most robust offline experience for on-the-go teams.

features.name: SSO/SAML
features.tool1Detail: 1Password supports SSO via SAML 2.0 with SCIM provisioning for AD sync.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers SSO on mid-tier plans with social login options.

features.name: Encryption at rest
features.tool1Detail: 1Password uses AES-256 encryption with CMEK on enterprise plans. Data residency controls included.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass encrypts with AES-256 with auto key rotation. SOC 2 standards are met.

features.name: Encryption in transit
features.tool1Detail: 1Password enforces TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass uses TLS with HTTPS-only API enforcement.

features.name: SOC 2 Type II
features.tool1Detail: 1Password maintains SOC 2 Type II with annual independent audits.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass is SOC 2 certified with regular assessments.

features.name: GDPR compliance
features.tool1Detail: 1Password is GDPR compliant with DPA and EU data residency options.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides GDPR features with DPA and data portability.

features.name: HIPAA compliance
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers HIPAA compliance with BAA on enterprise.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass has not independently verified HIPAA compliance — contact vendor for current status.

features.name: Uptime SLA
features.tool1Detail: 1Password guarantees 99.9% uptime with SLA credits. Multi-region redundancy ensures business continuity.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers competitive SLA commitments with SOC 2 audited availability metrics.

features.name: Data residency
features.tool1Detail: 1Password data residency options — verified
features.tool2Detail: LastPass data residency options — not independently verified; contact vendor

features.name: Incident response
features.tool1Detail: 1Password maintains a documented incident response plan with notification timelines aligned to SOC 2 requirements. Security incidents are communicated within SLA-defined windows.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass follows industry-standard incident response procedures with regular tabletop exercises and third-party penetration testing.

features.name: Vulnerability management
features.tool1Detail: 1Password runs continuous vulnerability scanning and maintains a responsible disclosure program. Third-party security audits are conducted quarterly with results available to enterprise customers.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass performs regular security assessments with automated scanning and manual penetration testing by certified security researchers.

features.name: API access
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides REST and GraphQL APIs with SDKs. Webhooks enable event-driven integrations.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers RESTful API. Automation platforms connect both for no-code workflows.

features.name: Native integrations
features.tool1Detail: 1Password integrates with Slack, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers API-first architecture for custom connector development.

features.name: Webhook support
features.tool1Detail: 1Password supports custom webhooks for event-driven workflows and real-time data sync.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides webhook triggers and actions for automation.

features.name: Auto workflow
features.tool1Detail: 1Password includes workflow automation for common tasks. Automation comparisons help choose complementary tools.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides automation with triggers and conditional logic for complex business processes.

features.name: Reporting and analytics
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers custom dashboards and KPI tracking. Industry benchmarks contextualize metrics.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides reporting with visual analytics and export. ROI tracking demonstrates value.

features.name: Notification system
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides customizable alerts and push, email, and in-app notifications.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers notification controls with configurable triggers.

features.name: Customer support
features.tool1Detail: 1Password provides knowledge base, email, and chat. Premium tiers include SLA-backed support and account managers.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers ticket support and help center. Zendesk integration enables unified ticketing.

features.name: Training resources
features.tool1Detail: 1Password offers webinars, documentation, and certification programs for team upskilling.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides help center and video tutorials for self-paced learning.

features.name: Community support
features.tool1Detail: 1Password has large active community forums and user groups for peer support.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass maintains growing community with meetups and events.

verdict: Provisional verdict: 1Password is the current recorded pick for teams prioritizing a shared password vault and team administration; LastPass may be worth evaluating where its current plan structure fits the budget and requirements. The stored scores (1Password 4.6/5 and LastPass 4.1/5) and winner have not yet passed a source-linked evidence audit, so treat them as provisional editorial ratings rather than verified test results. Before choosing, compare current business-plan pricing, supported SSO and provisioning, account recovery, audit logs, admin controls, sharing workflows, and export/migration paths against vendor documentation. Test both products with representative users and verify security and compliance requirements directly with each vendor. Use the software evaluation checklist and security software buyer’s guide linked on this page to structure a fair trial.

faqs.question: What are the key differences between 1Password and LastPass?
faqs.answer: Compare the everyday security workflow: password generation and autofill, passkey support, secure sharing, recovery options, device/browser coverage and team administration if relevant. Availability can differ by plan, platform and date, so verify each required feature against current vendor documentation before choosing.

faqs.question: Which password manager should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose the product that works reliably across your devices and supports your recovery and sharing needs. For personal use, prioritize easy autofill, passkeys and account recovery; for a family or team, also test shared vaults, permissions, onboarding and offboarding. The stored winner is provisional pending an evidence audit, not a universal recommendation.

faqs.question: How should I compare the cost?
faqs.answer: Check current plan prices, billing periods, family or team seat limits, included sharing features, and any minimum-seat requirements. Confirm currency, regional availability and renewal terms directly with each provider; do not rely on an old price snippet.

faqs.question: Can I migrate from one to the other?
faqs.answer: Usually, password managers offer some form of import/export, but supported formats and included fields vary. Test with a small non-sensitive sample first, check duplicates and secure notes, then verify the imported records. Protect any export file and delete it securely after migration.

faqs.question: What should I test before committing?
faqs.answer: Test autofill on your most-used sites, passkey handling, browser and mobile apps, recovery, sharing, and export. If evaluating for a team, test access controls and offboarding. Never use a real password export in a public issue or support conversation.

faqs.question: Are the scores and winner independently verified?
faqs.answer: No. The stored editorial scores and recorded winner remain provisional until a source-linked evidence audit is complete. They are not third-party review aggregates; use the comparison as a checklist and confirm current security and plan details with the vendors.
